description: Defines an enum GatewayConnectionIssue for representing various connection issues related to a gateway, with methods for detection and extraction of request IDs from status texts.

methods.name: detect(from:)
methods.description: Detects the type of gateway connection issue based on a status text string.

methods.name: extractRequestId(from:)
methods.description: Extracts a request ID from a status text string, if present.
